hints.title: Color Run Insertion and Collapse
hints.text: Inserting balls into the sequence triggers cascading collapses whenever three or more adjacent balls share identical colors.

hints.title: Recursive Board Cleaning
hints.text: Implement a cleanup function that repeatedly scans for runs of three or more consecutive identical balls and splices them out until no runs remain.

hints.title: Breadth-First State Search with Pruning
hints.text: Search state pairs of board string and hand inventory. Insert each available hand color only at promising locations: adjacent to same color or between two balls of equal color differing from insert color.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inserting into arbitrary positions generates vast combinatorial cycles.
